name: greeting_prefix
label: Greeting
help_text: Word before the member's first name, e.g. "Hi" → "Hi Jane,".

name: firstname_fallback
label: First Name Fallback
help_text: Shown when the referred member has no first name on file.

name: referrer_fallback
label: Referrer Name Fallback
help_text: Used in place of {referrer} when the referrer_name property is empty.

name: intro_line
label: Intro Line
help_text: Opening sentence. Use {referrer} where the referrer's name should appear (from referrer_name; falls back to the value above).
default: {referrer} thought you might be interested in one of our services and has referred you through VIPSCLUB.

name: recommended_label
label: Recommended Service Label
help_text: Small heading above the recommended service. Only shown when a service was referred.

name: message_label
label: Message Label
help_text: Optional small heading above the referrer's message. Leave empty to show just the quote.

name: member_line
label: Already-a-Member Line
help_text: Explains they don't need to sign up — just log in to view the service.
default: As you're already a VIPSCLUB member, there's nothing you need to sign up for — simply log in to your portal to learn more, or submit an enquiry if you'd like to discuss this service with our team.

name: button_text
label: Button Text
help_text: Call-to-action button label. Leave empty to hide the button.

name: button_url_fallback
label: Button Fallback Link
help_text: Used only when no specific service was referred. Otherwise the button links to the referred service automatically.

name: closing_line
label: Closing Line
help_text: Warm closing sentence above the sign-off.
default: Thanks again for being part of VIPSCLUB. We look forward to helping you with your next step.

name: team_name
label: Team Name
help_text: Sender name shown under the sign-off.

name: accent_color
label: Accent Color
help_text: Brand colour for the service link, message bar, and button. Defaults to VIPSCLUB red.
